situations.title: 체크리스트 항목 순차 점검
situations.tagline: Let's go through your pre-op checklist together, step by step.
situations.brief: 수술 전 체크리스트를 항목별로 순차 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to confirm a few things before your surgery.
Can you tell me your name and date of birth?
What procedure are you having today?

situations.title: 검사 결과 도착 확인
situations.tagline: Have all the required labs and imaging come back for this patient?
situations.brief: 수술에 필요한 검사와 영상이 모두 도착했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Are all the labs and imaging back in the chart?
The CBC and type-and-screen are both here.
I'll flag anything that's still pending.
goals: 필수 검사와 영상 도착 여부를 확인한다

situations.title: 정맥로 개통 확인
situations.tagline: Let me check that your IV line is working well before we go in.
situations.brief: 정맥로가 잘 개통되어 있고 수액이 흐르는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking that your IV is running well.
Let me know if you feel any burning at the site.
This line will give you fluids and medication during surgery.

situations.title: 장신구·의치 제거 확인
situations.tagline: Before surgery, we'll need to remove any jewelry, dentures, or metal you have on.
situations.brief: 금속 장신구와 의치를 제거했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have any rings, piercings, or dentures on?
We remove metal so it doesn't interfere with the equipment.
I'll keep your belongings in a labeled bag for you.

situations.title: 방광 비움 확인
situations.tagline: Have you had a chance to empty your bladder before we take you in?
situations.brief: 배뇨 또는 도뇨로 방광이 비워졌는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you emptied your bladder recently?
If not, I can help you to the restroom now.
This keeps you comfortable during the procedure.

situations.title: 예방적 항생제 준비
situations.tagline: Is the prophylactic antibiotic drawn up and ready to give before incision?
situations.brief: 절개 전 예방적 항생제를 정해진 시각에 투여할 수 있게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The pre-op antibiotic is ready to give.
We need it in within 60 minutes before incision.
I'll document the exact time it goes in.
goals: 예방적 항생제를 절개 전 투여 준비한다

situations.title: 혈액형·교차적합 미완료
situations.tagline: The type-and-crossmatch isn't back yet, and this case may need blood.
situations.brief: 수혈 준비가 누락된 상태를 즉시 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The crossmatch is still incomplete.
Should we hold until blood is available?
I'll call the blood bank to expedite it.

situations.title: 필수 검사 결과 누락
situations.tagline: A required lab is missing—can we proceed, or do we need to hold?
situations.brief: 필수 검사 결과 누락 시 수술 진행 가부를 판단하도록 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The required potassium level isn't back yet.
Do we hold the case until it results?
I'll let the surgeon and anesthesia know.

situations.title: 인공관절·심박동기 정보
situations.tagline: Do you have any implants like a joint replacement or a pacemaker?
situations.brief: 이식물과 기기 정보를 확인해 수술팀에 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have a pacemaker or any metal implants?
When and where was it placed?
I'll pass this to the surgical team.

situations.title: 항생제 투여 시각 지연
situations.tagline: The antibiotic timing is slipping—we need it in before incision.
situations.brief: 항생제 투여가 절개 60분 이내에 들어가도록 시각을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: The antibiotic hasn't gone in yet.
Can we give it now, before incision?
I'll adjust the timing and document it.

situations.title: 정맥로 불량 재확보
situations.tagline: This IV isn't running well, so I'm going to place a new line for you.
situations.brief: 불량한 정맥로를 재확보하고 적절한 부위를 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: This line isn't flowing well, so I'll start a new one.
You'll feel a small pinch.
I'm choosing a better spot for the surgery.

situations.title: 의치·보청기 제거 거부
situations.tagline: I understand it's uncomfortable, but we do need the dentures out before surgery.
situations.brief: 의치와 보청기 제거의 필요성을 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The dentures need to come out for your airway to stay safe.
We'll keep them labeled and return them in recovery.
It's only for a short time during the procedure.

situations.title: 수술 전 VTE 예방 확인
situations.tagline: I'm putting compression sleeves on your legs to prevent blood clots during surgery.
situations.brief: 수술 전 혈전 예방 조치가 적용되었는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: These sleeves gently squeeze your legs to prevent clots.
Have you been given a blood thinner today?
I'll confirm the VTE prevention orders.

situations.title: 당뇨 환자 혈당 조절
situations.tagline: Let me check your blood sugar before surgery to make sure it's in a safe range.
situations.brief: 수술 전 당뇨 환자의 혈당을 확인하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your blood sugar now.
Did you take your insulin or diabetes pills this morning?
We'll adjust if the number is too high or low.
goals: 필요 시 혈당 조절 조치를 취한다

situations.title: 기록 간 정보 불일치
situations.tagline: The consent and the chart don't match—let's reconcile this before we start.
situations.brief: 기록 간 정보 불일치를 발견해 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: The consent says left, but the chart says right.
We need to stop and verify before proceeding.
I'll get the surgeon to confirm the correct side.

situations.title: 검사 이상치 수술 지연
situations.tagline: This lab value is critical—I'm reporting it now before we go any further.
situations.brief: 위험한 검사치를 즉시 보고해 수술 지연 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: The potassium is critically high at 6.8.
We should hold the case until this is corrected.
I'm calling the surgeon and anesthesia right now.

situations.title: 항생제 미투여 절개 임박
situations.tagline: Hold on—the antibiotic still hasn't gone in and we're about to make the incision.
situations.brief: 절개 직전 항생제 누락을 차단하고 투여를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop—the antibiotic hasn't been given yet.
Can we hold incision until it's infused?
I'm giving it now and documenting the time.

situations.title: 교차혈액 없이 출혈 수술
situations.tagline: We have no crossmatched blood and this bleeding case is starting—we need product now.
situations.brief: 혈액이 확보되지 않은 채 출혈 수술이 임박한 상황에 긴급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We have no crossmatched blood available.
Can we release emergency O-negative now?
I'm activating the massive transfusion protocol.

situations.title: 심박동기 환자 소작 위험
situations.tagline: This patient has a pacemaker—we need to manage the cautery risk before we cut.
situations.brief: 심박동기 환자에게서 전기소작 위험을 경고하고 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: The patient has a pacemaker—cautery could interfere with it.
We should use bipolar and place the pad away from the device.
Do we need cardiology or a magnet on standby?

situations.title: 응급 체크리스트 생략 압박
situations.tagline: I know we're rushing, but we can't skip the safety checks—let's do the time-out.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서도 필수 안전 항목을 사수하도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We still need the time-out even in an emergency.
It only takes thirty seconds to confirm the essentials.
Patient, site, and procedure—let's verify together.
goals: 필수 안전 항목 생략 압박에 대응한다

situations.title: 이식물 정보 불명 응급
situations.tagline: We don't know what implant this patient has—we need to work around the unknown safely.
situations.brief: 미상 이식물 정보 부재 상황에 안전하게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We can't confirm what implant is in place.
Let's get imaging and assume it's MRI-unsafe for now.
I'll try to reach the family or prior records.
goals: 정보 부재 하 안전 조치를 조율한다
